name: Upgrade Test

# Release-gated and manually triggerable. Runs the out-of-process cross-binary upgrade harness
# (`crates/ika-upgrade-test/`) on the `ika-k8s-large` self-hosted runner.
# Unlike the in-process cluster/integration suites, this spawns REAL,
# separately-compiled `ika-validator` child processes against an external
# `sui` localnet, swaps binaries across epochs, and asserts the in-place
# protocol-version upgrade contract (see
# dev-docs/specs/cross-binary-upgrade.md).
#
# Manual dispatch can run any scenario. Relevant pull requests run only
# `v145_rollout`, avoiding the full expensive matrix on unrelated changes.
# (The v3/v4-era rehearsals — cross_binary, v118_*, v121_rollout — were
# retired when protocol v3/v4 support was removed; v145_rollout is their
# successor against the current v1.4.5 release.) Pick the scenario with
# the `test` input:
#
#   smoke        — go/no-go plumbing: 4 same-binary processes reach epoch 2.
#                  Needs only the current build. Fastest.
#   workload     — full user DKG -> Presign -> Sign on-chain at genesis
#                  protocol v7. Current build only.
#   v145_rollout — the deployed-release compatibility gate: boot the literal
#                  v1.4.5 release (one commit for mainnet AND testnet, which
#                  run protocol v7 — the only version either binary supports,
#                  so the run genesises there),
#                  upgrade exactly one validator to the current build,
#                  converge two mixed aggregated reshares with
#                  zero malicious reports and per-authority output
#                  byte-equality, then swap the rest and converge again — a
#                  pure binary swap, no protocol transition. Defaults to
#                  old_ref=release/mainnet-v1.4.5, old_bin_name=ika-validator.
#                  Retargeting from v1.4.1 moved the OLD side across
#                  v1.4.2-v1.4.5: the Sui mainnet-v1.77.2 -> v1.83.1 move
#                  (#2146 consensus-owned replay and raw consensus-key
#                  authority labels, #2182), the published-inkrypto key
#                  derivation (#2168), startup MPC-input/key-mapping
#                  preparation (#2138 with #2190's boot-replay fix, #2176)
#                  and the OCS read-path fixes. The v141 gates straddled
#                  those; both sides of this one are past them, so none is
#                  straddled here.
#                  v1.4.5 decodes Sui's TransactionExpiration::Validity, so
#                  the OLD side now runs on the default localnet: the
#                  UPGRADE_TEST_LEGACY_SUI_TRANSACTIONS carve-out literal
#                  v1.4.1 needed is gone (see
#                  dev-docs/specs/cross-binary-upgrade.md).
#                  Immediately after a retarget, `main` == the OLD tag, so
#                  the gate is a same-binary run; real cross-binary coverage
#                  returns as `main` diverges.
#                  v1.4.5 is post-#2074, so — as with the v1.4.0 and v1.4.1
#                  gates before it, and unlike the v1.3.1-based one — this
#                  mixed committee shares ONE storage model. Crossing the
#                  event-sourcing change is no longer covered by anything:
#                  mid_epoch_rollback was the only scenario that did it and
#                  was retired once v1.4.0 shipped (see
#                  dev-docs/specs/event-sourced-epoch.md, "Rolling back").
#   v145_

name: Checks

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  pull_request:

jobs:
  checks:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      # submodules: the SoloPlay submodule cannot be checked in isolation (its tsconfig points at
      # ../../sdk and ../../libs), so the parent checkout is where it gets validated - against the
      # exact commit this repo pins.
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          submodules: recursive

      # Node 24: eslint-plugin-es-x@10 requires ^22.23.0 || ^24.18.0 || >=26.4.0, and
      # eslint@10 requires ^20.19.0 || ^22.13.0 || >=24. Anything older cannot run the toolchain.
      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version: '24'
          cache: npm

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      # lint:check, never `lint` - that one is `eslint --fix`, which would rewrite files in CI
      # and let anything auto-fixable pass silently.
      - name: ESLint
        run: npm run lint:check

      - name: Typecheck
        run: npm run typecheck

      # The no-undef inventory is generated. If someone adds a global without regenerating,
      # the committed file goes stale and no-undef quietly stops covering it.
      - name: Globals inventory is current
        run: npm run globals:check

      - name: Typecheck (SoloPlay submodule)
        run: npm run typecheck:soloplay

      # Every runtime .js must belong to a TS program. A file in none gets no typechecking and
      # no editor intellisense, and nothing else reports it.
      - name: No orphaned files
        run: node tools/audit/program-files.mjs --check
